items.description: With the SpaceX satellite system faltering, Ukraine’s military launched a surprise, multi-pronged attack to take down vital bridge to CrimeaAt 10pm on Monday evening a Ukrainian soldier scrawled a message on a kamikaze drone. items.title: Fresh clashes at the Eritrean border — is Ethiopia sliding into a regional war?
items.description: As Ethiopian troops push Tigrayan forces toward the Eritrean border, fears of a new regional war are growing. With tensions rising between Ethiopia, Eritrea and Sudan, the Horn of Africa faces uncertain times ahead.

items.title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
items.description: One of the key symbols of Russia's occupation of Ukraine has suffered major damage after a seven-stage attack by Kyiv.

items.title: Estonia closes its border with Russia but can it keep Moscow out?
items.description: Estonia announced this weekend it would close its border with Russia, after blaming its eastern neighbour of attempting to sabotage one of its drone factories. But at a time when the internet has become one of Russia’s most potent weapons to wage hybrid warfare, does closing the border even matter?

items.title: Missing Pro-War Blogger May Face Treason Charges Over Oleshky Evacuation Post
items.description: Vladimir Romanov had suggested that the optics of the U.S.-brokered ceasefire and evacuation effort in Oleshky were unfavorable for Russia.

items.title: Russia calls French troops presence in Ukraine a 'direct participation in war'
items.description: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on Tuesday said a message had been issued to Paris. The deputy French defense minister said it was 'absurd' to claim the soldiers were there to fight.

items.title: Russia Rejects Black Sea Ceasefire Without Full Peace Deal, Turkey Says
items.description: Russia is unwilling to agree to a temporary ceasefire in the Black Sea without a comprehensive peace deal with Ukraine, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said. He identified the dispute over Donbas – which Russia wants Ukraine to surrender – as the main obstacle to ending the war. The remarks come as Washington push…

items.title: From Russia's Infamous Gold-Mining Region, A Ready Supply Of Men For Ukraine War
items.description: Before he signed up to fight in Ukraine, Denis Dmitriyev served time for robbing another gold-mining laborer in Kolyma. He is one of at least 20 men from the legendarily harsh Russian gold-mining region in war who have been killed in the war. Nearly all were convicted criminals or chronic debtors.

items.title: First Person: Managing risk on Ukraine’s frontline
items.description: Humanitarian workers providing support to communities on the frontline of the war between Ukraine and Russia must balance remaining close to those in need with the heightened risks of operating in a conflict zone, according to the top UN official in Ukraine.
